findings.item_title: This item was considered by the Economic and Community Development Committee on February 20, 2024 and adopted without amendment. It will be considered by City Council on March 20 and 21, 2024.
findings.quote: Residents expressed strong concern that all of the options for the RapidTO: Jane Street project propose bus stop removals, and firmly opposed bus stop removals even if they increase overall travel times.
findings.rule: bus stop removals, and firmly opposed bus stop removals

findings.quote: Coordinate with the planning process for RapidTO along Jane Street, with consideration for location of future bus stops and/or bus stop removals, aligning with TTC policy.
findings.rule: bus stops and/or bus stop removals
